verdict.rationale: Quo publishes a public API reference with API-key generation, header-based authentication, per-key revocation, rate limits of 10 requests per second, standardized JSON responses, and a 'Build with AI LLMs' guide. The homepage also markets an API 'your own agent can read and act on.' missing for 10: evidence of which resources and endpoints the API covers, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
